__comment: The IDLE model wears trommel_drum_still, a one-frame crop of the sheet; the _running model wears the sheet itself. Both files existed before and were BYTE-IDENTICAL, so the drum turned whether or not the machine had power or material - and the ACTIVE blockstate, the mirror that writes it onto every cell, and the CELL stamping were all driving a distinction the art did not make. Neither GameTest nor JUnit can see a block face, which is why this survived a green suite and died in one screenshot.
